checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)
checks.note: today would be breakout 4 of this move

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=10 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.3 tightness=0.73 base_volume_vs_leg=0.79 base_volume_vs_avg=0.91
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: volume did not exceed the prior session's

notes: extension: close -0.6% vs its 20-SMA, -4.6% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 1 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The mechanical grade is A but three independent quality failures drag it down: Y is a hard FAIL (this would be the fourth breakout of the move, with three prior breakouts already recorded in 46 sessions), RE is a hard FAIL (the burst bar at 3% range is only 56% of the prior 5-bar maximum, not an expansion), and VOL is a hard FAIL (volume came in at 42% of the prior session, well below any threshold). The chart confirms all three: the base sits at the top of a long, mature staircase advance from ~$55 to ~$89, the signal bar shows no range expansion relative to recent bars, and volume is visibly thin on the signal day.
claude.key_risk: This is the fourth push out of a multi-month advance with shrinking volume and no range expansion — the classic late-stage setup where buyers are exhausted.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the signal day's close of $81.01 or if volume in the first 30 minutes is tracking below the already-thin signal-day pace.
